verdict.rationale: Tavily has a dedicated Crawl endpoint that traverses a site from a base URL as a graph, exploring hundreds of paths in parallel with built-in extraction. It supports natural-language instructions, and the CLI exposes a `--depth` control. A companion Map endpoint discovers full site structure, so a data engineer can crawl subpages or whole sites from any URL a search returns. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of chaining a search result directly into a crawl, and independent or hands-on corroboration of crawl behavior and limits (crawl is also unavailable in keyless mode).
